column2: [intro]
In the morning I wake up full of energy
I run everywhere, I'm never bored
My socks are pink, my shoes a mess
My wardrobe is a battlefield
I'm messy, oh yes, it's true
But my disorder is my pride
I seek chaos in my perfect life
The paradox is my quest
I make lists, organize my days
But I scatter, I get lost in my ideas
My papers pile up, my files are lost
My desk is a chaos where I feel adrift
I'm a perfectionist, it itches me
But to tidy up, I prefer the mix
My necklaces tangle, my drawers overflow
In my universe, order is in disagreement
[ solo ]
I'm messy, oh yes, it's true
But my disorder is my pride
I seek chaos in my perfect life
The paradox is my quest
[ outro ]
